# PrintKit NYC — Photo Printer Rental in NYC

PrintKit NYC rents professional DNP DS40 photo printers in New York City. The kit is pickup-only in Clinton Hill, Brooklyn, and includes everything you need for short-term photo printing at events, projects, or DIY setups.

## What’s included

- DNP DS40 professional dye-sub photo printer
- Protective travel case
- Power and USB cables
- Quick-start setup guide

## Pricing

- Daily printer rental: $100 per day
- Media kit: one roll, loaded and test-printed before pickup. 4×6 is $100 for 400 prints; 6×8 and 5×7 are available too. Customers may bring their own DNP DS40 media instead
- WCMPlus Print Server: $35 per day for wireless printing from any device on the network
- Refundable security deposit: $200 required for all rentals; refunded within 48 hours of return in working condition
- Applicable sales tax is added to the rental and optional add-ons; the refundable security deposit is not taxed

## Service area

Pickup is in Clinton Hill, Brooklyn, New York. Rentals are available to customers in NYC and the surrounding area.

## How to book

Request your rental dates at https://printkitnyc.com/request. We review availability and reply by text message or email within 1–2 business days. If the dates are available, we send the rental agreement for signature, followed by payment details. Payment must be received before pickup.

## Support

Setup help and troubleshooting are available by email at hello@printkitnyc.com during your rental. There is no published phone line and no guaranteed replacement unit.
